title: Launch page decisions
ask: Pick a direction for the three decisions below so the launch page can be built this week.
summary: The launch page is blocked on layout, signup scope and the headline. Each question carries a recommendation, so accepting all three takes a minute.
findings: The current hero image is 2.1 MB and is the slowest thing on the page.
Most visitors arrive on a phone.
The signup form currently asks for six fields.
boundary: Detail below: about 2 minutes. Read it if you need to know what each option changes or why one is recommended.

questions.title: Which hero layout should the page use?
questions.body: The page needs one hero. Option A keeps the large image and loads slowest on a phone. Option B uses a text-only hero that loads instantly but is plainer.
questions.tradeoff: A looks richer; B is about two seconds faster on a slow connection.

options.label: Keep the image hero, compressed to under 300 KB.
Use the text-only hero, and move the image further down the page.

questions.title: Which signup fields are required?
questions.body: Every required field lowers completion. Email is the only field the welcome flow needs; the rest can be asked later.

options.label: Email (needed to send the welcome message)
Name (used to personalise the welcome message)

questions.title: What should the headline say?
questions.body: One line, under ten words, in the voice the rest of the site uses. Leave it blank and the current draft headline ships.
